key_insight: An LLM guided by a circuit verifier evolves programs that generate fault-tolerant Clifford circuits for multiple encoded quantum-computing tasks.
engineering_relevance: The approach could reduce manual circuit-design effort for logical state preparation, logical gates, code-switching, and code growth.
method: Frame circuit design as agentic evolutionary program synthesis.
Use an LLM’s pretrained knowledge and tool-use capabilities to evolve circuit-generating programs.
Guide the search with a circuit verifier and exhaustively check faults.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports fault-tolerant circuits for all curated tasks considered, each verified by exhaustive fault checking, but gives no quantitative benchmarks.
watch_item: Scalability of exhaustive fault verification to larger codes and circuits remains unclear from the abstract.
paper_title: Agentic AI for Discovering Fault-Tolerant Quantum Circuits
